name: 无情风云
english_name: Wu Qing Feng Yun (Invincible Under Heaven)
english_description: The Zhengzhou Fengyun "Collector's Edition," branded in-game as "Invincible Under Heaven," is a wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels rather than the more common Jin Yong universe, with sect and faction names to match. It shares an identical codebase with this collection's zzfy3 (Zhengzhou Fengyun 3) — a relationship not previously documented between the two archives.
